instruction: From the payment record, identify all students whose email addresses begin with letters a through d and add these addresses to the recipient field of your email draft.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding students whose email addresses start with letters a-d. Verified with Python: 4 students match (Alice with alice@, Bob with bob@, Carol with carol@, Dave with dave@).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_accessibility_tree' correctly extracts the Thunderbird UI state from the accessibility tree
Metric 'check_accessibility_tree' correctly uses CSS selectors to verify presence of email address pills in the To field

All 4 required email addresses (alice@, bob@, carol@, dave@) are individually verified with appropriate selectors targeting 'tool-bar[attr|id=MsgHeadersToolbar] label[name=To]~[attr|class="address-pill"]'
Expected values are semantically correct - alice@, bob@, carol@, dave@ all have local parts starting with letters a-d as required
Postconfig includes sleep 10 seconds to allow Thunderbird compose window to fully load before verification

Minor semantic gap: Evaluator only checks for presence of the 4 required emails, but does not verify exclusivity (i.e., that NO extra emails outside the a-d range were incorrectly added). If agent added extra emails starting with e-z, evaluator would still pass.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a count verification to ensure EXACTLY 4 address pills are present in the To field, preventing false positives from extra emails being added
Alternatively, could add negative rules to explicitly check that no emails starting with letters e-z are present in the To field
